title: Hypothesis 3.1 of the monotonicity formula holds μ_V-a.e. (remark in Simon Lemma 8.3.6)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, and let V be an n-varifold on U (SimonGMT Varifold N n U; U is open) with locally bounded first variation in U. Then for μ_V-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^N there are real numbers R > 0 and Λ ≥ 0 with closedBall x R ⊆ U and ‖δV‖(B_r(x)) ≤ ofReal(Λ)·μ_V(B_r(x)) for every 0 < r < R. Here B_r(x) = closedBall x r, μ_V = V.weight and ‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ R Λ : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ closedBall x R ⊆ U ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < R → variationMeasure V (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x r)
